fields.description: The Woods Retreat is a separate apartment release within Sobha Sanctuary in Al Yufrah, Dubai. One- and two-bedroom homes form part of a landscaped setting with wellness and resident spaces. Its own plans identify A-series unit examples and several layout variants.

overview: Retreat provides a dedicated 32-page plan pack. The two-bedroom Type A example uses a larger balcony than Type B, while both remain distinct from the similarly named Abode and Serenity types. Compare the selected apartment against its own tower and level schedule.
research.locationNote: Sobha locates The Woods Retreat within Sobha Sanctuary in Al Yufrah, with road access through the surrounding Dubailand district. Confirm the selected building, route and outlook rather than treating a general community map as a unit pin.
research.priceNote: The current project-page price panel starts at AED 1.20m, subject to inventory. Its FAQ and Property Finder still quote AED 999,000. Those figures have not been treated as proof of current availability at the lower amount; obtain a dated unit offer.
research.paymentNote: The 20/40/40 aggregate below is Property Finder's reported reference. No developer-issued dated instalment calendar was located in the official brochure or page. Confirm the applicable plan, booking amount and deadlines in writing.
research.handoverNote: The current Sobha catalogue lists 2029. Secondary references quote Q4 2029; confirm the unit's contractual programme and handover arrangements.
